en.headline: sogeisetsu: 297 commits, 25 PRs, 41 issues across 30 days
en.overview:
Over the 30-day window from 2026-09-16 to 2026-10-15, the account recorded 297 commits, 25 pull requests, 41 issues, and 0 reviews. All 30 days of the window have data; no days are missing. Because the window spans the backfill boundary, earlier dates (2026-09-16 through 2026-10-01) were reconstructed via GitHub Search and are approximate: star counts are unavailable, releases cover only the user's own repositories, and issue, review, discussion, and comment figures are search-derived approximations. Commit counts come from a repository scan and are accurate.

Commit activity was concentrated in three repositories. `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` accounted for 139 own commits with no automated commits, `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` for 76 own commits, and `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` for 59 own commits plus 208 automated commits. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` contributed 19 own commits, `sogeisetsu/myBlog` 3, `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 1, and `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-creator` 0 own commits plus 5 automated commits.

Pull requests were split between the user's own work and contributions to other projects. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, PRs #1 through #8 were opened and merged on 2026-09-21, covering releases from v1.3.0 through v1.7.0. Four PRs (#39, #40, #41, #42) were opened in `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` on 2026-09-28 and closed on 2026-10-01. One PR (#1103) was opened in `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills` on 2026-09-25 and closed on 2026-09-29.

Issue activity was dominated by `openchamber/openchamber`, where the user opened or commented on issues including #4111, #4337, #4345, #4346, #4537, #4601, #4664, #4896, #4899, and #4920. Issues were also opened in `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim` (#1475), `anomalyco/opencode` (#50878, #51263), `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch` (#11), `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` (#180), `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` (#254, #458), `vercel-labs/skills` (#2297, #2298), and `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` (#38, #43). Seven discussions were started or commented on in `openchamber/openchamber` (#4502, #4599, #4600, #4821, #4823, #4893). No reviews were recorded.

Releases were published across three of the user's own repositories. `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` shipped 17 releases from v1.3.0 through v1.15.0 between 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-29. `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` shipped four releases from v0.1.0 through v0.4.0 between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-07. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` shipped three releases from v1.0.0 through v1.3.0 between 2026-09-25 and 2026-10-03.

byRepo.text: The most active repository with 139 own commits and no automated commits. Eight PRs (#1-#8) were opened and merged on 2026-09-21, covering releases from v1.3.0 through v1.7.0. Seventeen releases were published between 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-29, spanning v1.3.0 through v1.15.0. Work included automated doc checks, seven-language support, a Material docs site, rendered examples, a skills.sh install path, and a registry-first host-command scan.

59 own commits plus 208 automated commits. Work included switching all copy to English, adding a 30-day activity card with a daily auto-update workflow, upgrading CI actions to v7, and changing the daily report to a rolling 2-hour update cadence.

19 own commits and no automated commits. Three releases were published between 2026-09-25 and 2026-10-03, from v1.0.0 through v1.3.0. The project added an offline price seed, a two-question diagnostic, agent discovery scripts, and a snapshot summary tool.

The most active external repository for issues and discussions. Ten issues were opened or commented on, including #4111, #4337, #4345, #4346, #4537, #4601, #4664, #4896, #4899, and #4920. Seven discussions were started or commented on, including #4502, #4599, #4600, #4821, #4823, and #4893.
